title: The Race
description: The Race - a plugin that adds fantasy races to the server!
body:
# Races - Plugin for Paper Servers

Plugin adds a race and profession system to the server.

## Races:

### Dwarf - +Resistance I, +3% chance 2x ore, -4 inventory slots, 7❤
![Dwarf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c64eb3dd9b0926cc9fffbe33f64057395dbffc5d.png)
### Angel - +Slow Falling, +Regeneration I, cursed in Nether
![Angel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bec375b636a2b680f37d00e3ef90c697b817f1a3.png)
### Demon - +Fire Resistance, 11❤ in Nether, 7❤ outside Nether, vulnerable to water
![Demon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24ec978f96ce4c714eb52e4bfb8db3fcf506f8dc.png)
### Water - Dolphin's Grace I + Haste I in water, suffocation + Slowness I without water
![Water](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2734c6abf74baaab22b99632c9047a2486ff0a3b.png)
### Orc - 12❤, +Strength I, +Resistance I, -Slowness I, -Hunger I
![Orc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b021cd453389ccd191f2c10efca2f0cf8b5e6745.png)
### Elf - +Speed I, +Jump Boost I, Strength I with bow, no fall damage, -❤
![Elf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e8efafaf9f6997a7f701f2c2ac66643607216bb.png)
### Human - +15% XP
![Human](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e929aab6f65f640b612a5abd3577815ad9524dde.png)
### Zombie - no hunger loss, Night Vision, -Weakness I, Slowness I in water
![Zombie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9411b8c18dd5b416c56a4f5a08e769920997428f.png)
## Professions:

Alchemist - potions +15 seconds, 2% chance +1 effect level
Farmer - 5% chance +1 crop, food saturates 5% better
Enchanter - 2% chance +1 enchant level, +5% XP
Smith - armor breaks 7% slower, anvil repair 5% cheaper, 2% chance to not spend material
Archer - 5% chance to not consume arrow, 5% chance glowing arrow
![Profession](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b12d298adb94a26ec0fb16615fad47cfcf3ac6c2.png)
## Commands:

/race [info|choose|reset|set|reload|banlist] - race management
/profession [info|choose|reset|set] - profession management
/language [en|ru] - change interface language
Requirements:

Paper/Pufferfish/Purpur 1.20.6+
Java 17+
